translations.web: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
translations.bsb: The prudent see danger and take cover, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
translations.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
translations.asv: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
